title: PolyTrip.co | The Community Vacation Marketplace
excerpt: Join or host group-driven vacations. Secure your spot with a dynamic $50 deposit.
content_html:
How it works

From idea to launched trip — in under 5 minutes.

01

Describe

Tell the AI what you have in mind. Destination, vibe, dates, budget. It asks what's missing.

02

Invite

Share your trip page. People vote and secure their spot with a small deposit.

03

Launch

Once the group commits, the trip is real. PolyTrip handles coordination from there.

Why PolyTrip trips actually happen

Most group trips die in the group chat. Here's why ours don't.

The problem isn't finding people who want to travel. It's that saying "I'm in" costs nothing — so it means nothing.

PolyTrip solves this with a Dynamic Deposit: a small, refundable amount every participant puts down before anything is booked. When going somewhere costs something — people show up.

$50 deposit — Secures each spot. Refundable if the trip doesn't reach minimum participants.

Minimum threshold — The trip only launches when enough people commit. No fake trips.

Full transparency — Everyone sees who's in and how close the group is to launching.

Live Now — Ready to Book

5 active

Secure payments via Stripe · $50 refundable deposit

Built for everyone

You don't need to be a travel agent. You just need a trip in mind.

Platform features

Everything you need to run a group trip. Nothing you don't.

AI Trip Planner

Describe your trip in plain language. The AI builds the structure, suggests the itinerary, and helps you publish in minutes.

Dynamic Deposit

Participants commit with a small deposit before anything is booked. No deposit, no spot. No surprises.

Private & Public Trips

Keep your trip invite-only with a direct link, or list it publicly on the PolyTrip marketplace.

Host Dashboard

Track who's in, who's pending, and how close you are to your minimum — all in one place.

Lead Collection

Not ready to commit to a price? Collect interest first. Convert interested visitors into paying participants.

Flexible Pricing

Set your own price. Offer agent-managed pricing for custom quotes. PolyTrip takes a platform fee on successful bookings only.

FAQ

Got questions? We've got answers.

No. PolyTrip is built for anyone — whether you're organizing a friends trip, a community retreat, or a corporate offsite. If you have a trip in mind, you can launch it.

A Dynamic Deposit is a small, refundable amount (typically $50) that participants pay to secure their spot. The trip only launches when enough people commit. If the minimum isn't reached, deposits are refunded automatically.

No. PolyTrip is a technology platform. We help you plan, organize, and launch group trips — but the experiences are hosted by independent hosts. PolyTrip is not responsible for the trips themselves.

Any group experience — friends trips, wellness retreats, adventure travel, company offsites, community events, and more. If it involves a group going somewhere together, PolyTrip can handle it.

Hosts set their own prices. PolyTrip charges a platform fee on successful bookings. See our pricing page for full details.

Yes. You can launch a private trip accessible only via a direct link — it won't appear on the public marketplace.

If your trip doesn't reach its minimum participant threshold, all deposits are refunded in full. No one pays for a trip that doesn't happen.

Absolutely. Travel agents and tour operators use PolyTrip to list trips, collect deposits, and manage participants — without the administrative overhead.

Your trip idea is waiting.

Describe it. We'll help you make it real.

content_html_zh:
它是如何运作的

从想法到启动旅行——不到 5 分钟。

01

描述

告诉人工智能你的想法。 目的地、氛围、日期、预算。 它询问缺少什么。

02

邀请

分享您的旅行页面。 人们通过投票并支付小额押金来确保自己的位置。

03

发射

一旦团队做出承诺，这次旅行就是真正的。 PolyTrip 从那里处理协调。

为什么 PolyTrip 旅行实际上会发生

大多数跟团旅行都死在群聊里。 这就是我们不这样做的原因。

问题不在于找到想要旅行的人。 这就是说“我加入”不需要任何成本——所以它没有任何意义。

PolyTrip 通过动态押金解决了这个问题：每个参与者在预订任何东西之前存入一小笔可退还的金额。 当去某个地方需要付出一些代价时——人们就会出现。

50 美元押金 — 确保每个席位。 如果旅行未达到最低参加人数，可退款。

最低门槛——只有当有足够多的人参与时，旅行才会启动。 没有虚假的旅行。

完全透明——每个人都可以看到谁加入了以及该团体距离启动有多近。

立即直播 — 可供预订

5 活跃

通过 Stripe 安全付款 · 50 美元可退还押金

为所有人打造

您不需要成为旅行社。 你只需要考虑一次旅行。

平台特色

团体旅行所需的一切。 没有什么是你不知道的。

人工智能旅行计划

用通俗易懂的语言描述您的旅行。 人工智能会构建结构、建议行程并帮助您在几分钟内发布。

动态存款

参与者在预订任何东西之前须缴纳小额押金。 没有押金，没有现货。 没有什么惊喜。

私人和公共旅行

通过直接链接保留您的旅行仅限受邀者，或在 PolyTrip 市场上公开列出。

主机仪表板

跟踪谁已加入、谁正在等待，以及您距离最低限度有多近——所有这些都在一处完成。

铅收集

还没准备好承诺价格吗？ 先收利息。 将感兴趣的访客转化为付费参与者。

灵活的定价

设定您自己的价格。 为自定义报价提供代理管理的定价。 PolyTrip 仅对成功预订收取平台费。

FAQ

有疑问吗？ 我们已经得到答案了。

不会。PolyTrip 适合任何人 - 无论您是组织朋友旅行、社区静修还是公司异地活动。 如果您有旅行的想法，就可以启动它。

动态押金是参与者为获得席位而支付的小额可退还金额（通常为 50 美元）。 只有当有足够多的人参与时，旅行才会启动。 如果未达到最低金额，押金将自动退还。

不。PolyTrip 是一个技术平台。 我们帮助您计划、组织和发起团体旅行——但体验是由独立的房东主办的。 PolyTrip 对行程本身不承担任何责任。

任何团体体验——朋友旅行、健康静修、冒险旅行、公司异地、社区活动等等。 如果涉及一群人一起去某个地方，PolyTrip 可以处理。

房东自行定价。 PolyTrip 对成功预订收取平台费。 请参阅我们的定价页面了解完整详细信息。

是的。 您可以启动只能通过直接链接访问的私人旅行 - 它不会出现在公共市场上。

如果您的旅行未达到最低参与门槛，所有押金将全额退还。 没有人会为没有发生的旅行付费。

绝对地。 旅行社和旅游经营者使用 PolyTrip 列出行程、收取押金和管理参与者，而无需管理费用。

您的旅行想法正在等待。

描述一下。 我们将帮助您实现这一目标。
